challenge.method: Compare the grammar notation with identifier and string rules and the Office language scope at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/office/vba/api/overview/. Compile ASCII, mixed-case, full-width and mixed-width keyword spellings using Roslyn vbc 4.14.0-3.25279.5 (995f12b6).
challenge.results: The pinned specification rejects mixed-width terminal matching. The local compiler accepted all four test spellings, including U+FF30 followed by ASCII ublic in a class declaration. This is concrete contrary implementation behavior and bounds the finding to what the pinned grammar says.

limitations: Pinned Visual Basic for .NET grammar notation. Local Roslyn 4.14.0 accepted a mixed-width keyword token, so the finding applies only to the specified rule.
